## Description

Couples Neural Controlled Differential Equations with multivariate point processes to model continuous order arrival trajectories and optimize execution timing under irregular tick flow.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency institutional order execution, illiquid order book environments, irregular trade timing.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, HFT Prop Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, trade execution logs, quote timestamps.

## Caveats

Requires GPU acceleration and specialized numerical ODE solvers for continuous path control.
